structured.answer: I didn't choose anything. Only the government-bond track (גמל אג"ח ממשלתית, fee 0.52%) and the cash-like shekel track (גמל כספי) looked safe enough for me, and I'll go over them with my son or the bank before I do anything.

stuck.why: Dense table of numbers on a black background, with coloured rings and percentages over 100%; it made me anxious right away
The first company's name was cut off between screens, so I didn't know whose tracks I was looking at
Not sure if 4.9% for 3 years means per year or in total, or why the 5-year figure is lower
Two fees per row (מההחיסכון and מההפקדות); I didn't know which one counts

used: Title כל המסלולים בכל החברות and the lit-up product button תגמולים ואישית לפיצויים
Rows גמל אג"ח ממשלתית and גמל כספי (שקלי): fee and returns
Company group lines for מור and הפניקס with their fee ranges
גמל בניהול אישי 0.15%, which I rejected because the saver decides alone
skimmed: Yellow warning that the data was not updated since September 2026
Row of filter buttons (עוקב מדד, הלכה, 50-60, ...)
skipped: Coloured ring charts and the מניות/מט"ח percentages
Product tabs other than the selected one
unsure_meaning: תשואה שנתית ממוצעת לפני דמי ניהול: per year or total?
Why the 5-year return is lower than the 3-year return
not_found: A plain sentence saying which track is safe or low-risk
The name of the first company in the table
Who runs this site (a bank or an official body?)
A simple explanation of what the ring charts mean

findings.what: Very dense table: five or six numbers plus a ring chart per row, from the second screen on; overwhelming and frightening
Dark background with light and grey text is hard to read even enlarged
The first company's name scrolled out of view, so the rows lost their owner
Percentages over 100% (מניות 101%, אג"ח 103%) look like a mistake
No plain-language note about which tracks are safe or risky
The 5-year return is lower than the 3-year one with no explanation; it looks as if something fell
findings.where: Returns column, e.g. גמל אג"ח ממשלתית

findings.what: Small grey question marks and tags too faint to read
English letters (S&P) in buttons and track names
Unfamiliar site name מקור, not obviously official
